values.specimenType: Uterus, evacuation of retained products of gestation

report:
Uterus, evacuation of retained products of gestation

- Chorionic villi
   - Present (with hydropic change)
   - Villitis absent
   - Features of partial hydatidiform mole
- Decidua: Present
- Hypersecretory endometrium: Present
- Foetal parts: Absent

UTERUS, evacuation of retained products of gestation - Consistent with PARTIAL HYDATIDIFORM MOLE

p57KIP2 immunohistochemistry cannot distinguish a partial hydatidiform mole from a non-molar hydropic or aneuploid gestation; ploidy analysis or molecular genotyping is suggested to confirm the diagnosis. Serial serum hCG monitoring and referral to the trophoblastic disease service are recommended.

checks.message: Hydatidiform mole: communicate the result to the clinical team urgently if the diagnosis was not expected.
